notes: Keep distinct from vanilla drydocks: V1 is civil/commercial, while drydocks directly gates the military ship_of_the_line. A port/trade-capacity PM is the natural representation.

great_wave_dependency: ship_designer for player custom authoring only
notes: Do not invent a ship type. A country modifier to construction efficiency/ship quality is the least invasive representation.

notes: No chronometer component exists. Use fleet/ship supply or naval mission reach modifiers, not a weapon/hull.

notes: Ship groups classify military hulls, but they are combat-composition data, not civil classification societies.

notes: COPPER_SHEATHING_VANILLA_SUPPORT=NONE. A utility/range ship_modification is mechanically possible but needs default-template and non-DLC handling.

historical_role: Charting, soundings, safer routes and operational reach

notes: No hydrography object; map topology remains engine data.

vanilla_equivalent: generic fleet/ship readiness, screening and mission modifiers
notes: No doctrine/component slot exists for signals; country-applied fleet modifiers fit existing mechanics.

notes: Use the active shipyard PM/country_ship_construction capacity pattern; do not rely on the unreferenced pmg_military_base or create a second military shipyard building without need.

vanilla_equivalent: no diagonal framing or structural hull slot
notes: No WOODEN_HULL_STRUCTURAL_COMPONENT family exists. A shipyard construction/throughput modifier is safer than a new GUI slot.

historical_role: Lighthouse visibility, approach safety and port reach
notes: Represent on ports/state maritime infrastructure; a new ship component would be historically wrong.
